preconditions.description: Input constraints: n is the number of cards (1 to 100), k is the required total power (1 to 100000).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= 1000 and 1 <= c <= 100000 and 1 <= l <= n for p, c, l in cards)
preconditions.description: Each card has power p (1 to 1000), magic number c (1 to 100000), and level l (1 to n).
The input contains exactly n cards.

postconditions.description: Output is either -1 (no valid deck) or a valid level (1 to n).

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (min_level := int(stdout)) == min({l for l in range(1, n + 1) if any(subset_power >= k and all(c1 + c2 != prime for i in range(len(subset)) for j in range(i + 1, len(subset)) for c1, c2 in [(cards[subset[i]][1], cards[subset[j]][1])]) and all(cards[i][2] <= min_level for i in subset) for subset in subsets(cards) for subset_power in [sum(cards[i][0] for i in subset)])})
postconditions.description: If possible, output the minimum level l such that there exists a subset of cards with total power >= k, no two cards in the subset have magic numbers summing to a prime, and all cards in the subset have level <= l. Otherwise, output -1.
